name: primary_condition_v5
status: development reference selected under DEC-049/DEC-050; not frozen
supersedes: primary_condition_v4 (three pools, single final checkpoint); v3 stays the two-dataset fallback
condition: learned reader (tied cosine + pairwise null + lexical overlap, stop list v1), stable observations, per-position delta writes (5 normalized adjoint steps, tau 0.1, A 0.3, v2 b_m), hard top-1, null threshold 0.5, binary mass, top-k 4, R1-56 rare-token overlap gate (rare_overlap_min=1, rare_df_max=2); weights = uniform average of the step-150/200/250/300 checkpoints of one training run (R1-71)
training: stream-scale mixed-domain episodes over three pools (CounterFact v1 1,000; zsRE v1 1,000; MQuAKE v3 self-contained 500; 64-record memories; ordinary-text nulls 8/episode; question-form out-of-memory nulls at rate 1.0 (R1-66); locality nulls never equal to an in-memory own prompt (R1-65)); 300 steps x 2; lr 1e-3; wd 0.01; seed 2; bounded-shape trainer (R1-69); scripts/r1_50_stream_train.py --save-every 50

selection.rule: DEC-050: max mean RET-GS over zsRE/CounterFact/MQuAKE development streams (stream seed 21; MQuAKE dev v3b) subject to zsRE unseen false fires <= 10 % at 100 records (dev prompts) and LS >= 0.98 on every dataset; candidates = (run, checkpoint) pairs (DEC-049)

trade_off: unconstrained best candidates reach mean RET-GS 0.85-0.87 with 19-55 % zsRE unseen false fires at 100 records; the constrained winner sits at the 10 % limit (n = 100 prompts), so its admissibility is a point estimate at the boundary (R1-X12 review requested)
